title: Claire Danes and Ewan McGregor thriller The Spot gets a January release date
summary: The A24 drama series arrives on Hulu on 13 January.
body:
Hulu has announced that The Spot, a new drama series starring Claire Danes and Ewan McGregor, will begin on 13 January 2027. The first pictures from the show were released at the same time.

Danes plays a successful surgeon and McGregor her husband, a schoolteacher, who comes to suspect that she may be connected to a fatal hit-and-run.

Behind the series

The show was created and written by Ed Solomon, whose credits include the Bill & Ted and Now You See Me films. It is produced by A24 with 20th Television.

The cast also includes Daveed Diggs, Macon Blair and Michael Patrick Thornton.

Sources: Deadline, Screen Rant, BroadwayWorld.
